title: Patch: Update Buff Priorities
thread:
**Issue #1748 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1748: Patch: Update Buff Priorities
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

Two parts
1) When buffing/nerfing a permanent in play; increasing/decreasing the cost (or affecting the cry) is no longer a valid option
2) Add more valid buff targets for spells and field spells. All field spells can now be buffed to gain indestructible, damage dealing ones can gain pierce and life steal, or if they benefit from plague tokens can be buffed to have plague tokens played (or removed) from them. For each individual spell / field spell see if there are adjustable numbers to be buffed or nerfed. 

### Acceptance

All parts complete and merged into main. All field spells / spells audited.  

### Blocked by, part of

_No response_

### Difficulty (a guess)

hard: engine rules, the AI, design across crates, a migration, or about 40 files or more

### Priority

medium

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)
```
